name: list-user-secrets
description: List the names of personal secrets stored in the vault under the `user.*` namespace. Returns key names only — never values, and never system, channel, or API-key secrets. Call this BEFORE secret-capture-request or before filling a browser form with a secret_ref, so you reuse an existing key instead of guessing names or asking the user to re-enter a secret that is already stored. If a listed name matches what you need, pass that exact name to secret-capture-request to update it in place.

outputs.keys: string[] (user.* vault key names only, alphabetical, never values)
